observations.body: Login displays Username and Password fields and a Sign in button; demo Employee account emily.dawson is listed.
Login form is visible and ready for Employee credentials.
Signing in as emily.dawson opened the Employee dashboard.
Employee dashboard welcomes Emily, shows pending leave requests 0, and offers Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, Request leave, Fill timesheet, Notifications, and Log out.
My Leave shows 18 available days, a New request control, and one approved Vacation history entry for Aug 18–19, 2026 with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.

New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal types; required Start date and End date fields; an optional Reason field; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
A Vacation request with future dates Oct 5–6, 2026 and reason “Evaluation data” is ready to submit.
The date textboxes are read-only to direct fill; neither date contained a value.
Submitting with both dates empty showed “Please fill in all required fields.” and remained on New leave request.
Clicking Start date opens an in-page September 2026 calendar; this is the observed date-selection mechanism.
Timesheet shows draft week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday–Sunday hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
The draft has zero hours and Save draft is ready; any saved values will be evaluation data.
Saving the evaluation-data draft with Monday set to 1 recorded total 1 h and displayed “Draft saved.”
My Profile offers photo upload, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a read-only Email field, and Save changes.

Employee Directory loads 28 employees in a paginated table (page 1 of 3), with search by name, an All departments filter covering Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR, a disabled Previous button, and Next.
